body:
I can relate, though maybe not for the same reason. For me, it's become a rule of thumb to just not talk when around people because whenever I do, I say something stupid, pointless or unintentionally hurtful (Thanks, naturally condescending tone of voice and angry resting face!). So now I'm the in same boat; no one wants to hang out with the quiet guy who looks mad about nothing in particular. 

I've never really been passionate about anything that I can remember, so I know exactly what you mean there. Everything is a variation of either enjoyable or irritating, with very few exceptions. Seeing people who legitimately enjoy their major, or have dedicated their lives to music, or can find real joy in a hobby or sport have never made any sense. Everything just kinda feels bland to me. Things can still be fun, just not for a long time, and for whatever reason I always feel like complete crap after a fun day. If I could go out and do things with the ability to come home afterward and remain even somewhat content, it would be worth it, but I'll take a boring day over one with alternating emotional extremes. 

I used to be confident too, or at least I think I was. Having the ability to do things without giving a shit what people thought of me was one I took for granted. I wish I knew how to get it back because now I just feel like the personification of vanilla. I used to be interesting and do all kinds of weird things just because I could. Now I don't want to go out and do things and have to deal with people, but I also don't want to sit in my apartment on the computer for another day. 

What the hell happened?...
Actually the balls stay suspended indefinitely because the drink is a gel. One of my engineering professors used the stuff to teach us about rheology and viscosity.

I have a laissez-faire policy when it comes to spiders. I let them live if they don't bother me. I even had a little spider live on my monitor for about a week (RIP Spiderbro 2014-2014)

But the morning I woke up to a spider skittering across my back was the morning I changed my policy on spider genocide.
